findings.summary: RESOLVED: AC-4 now requires reproducible root-owned before/after throughput evidence; code-green cannot be reported as a proven speedup without the declared benchmark artifact.
findings.repro: The prior plan allowed focused regressions to pass without matched timing. The revised plan declares mandatory root-owned matched baseline/candidate L2 evidence and its required provenance fields.

limits: One genuine reviewer pass only; no synthetic multi-agent count is claimed. The benchmark remains unexecuted.
